mapper.select: SELECT g.id,g.goods_name,g.cover_img,g.goods_desc,s.size,s.color, s.price sku_price,s.stock sku_stock,gc.name cat_name FROM goods g LEFT JOIN goods_category_rel rel ON g.id = rel.goods_id LEFT JOIN goods_category gc ON rel.category_id = gc.id LEFT JOIN goods_sku s ON g.id = s.goods_id
